entries.zh: 集中化陆军单元组装器
一切都是为了集体。这一乐曲用于稳定化我们的工蜂和蜂巢的连接。
entries.en: Everything should serve the collective. This tune is used to stabilize the connection between our drones and the wider hive.

entries.zh:
出自一位异星哲学家讲义的译本。通过追随她的以自我牺牲来团结大众的理论，我们可以在基础建设方面取得极大进展。

“伟大的国度是建立在牺牲舒适的基础上的，它需要所有人共同背负这一责任。”——吟游诗人特丽莎
entries.en:
Translations of an alien philosopher's teachings. We could make great strides in infrastructure by following her advice on how to unify the people via self-sacrifice.

"A strong nation is built upon the sacrifice of comfort, as long as everyone is asked to carry the burden together." - Telisa, the Teller of Tales

entries.zh:
出自一位异星哲学家讲义的译本。这部分内容包括对生命和宇宙存在意义的多次思考。如果我们的统治者能够遵循这些建议，我们的执政会更加显得有先见之明。

“世界的意义在主体之外，但吾辈仍将上下而求索。我们必须团结一致，才能够探求万事万物的本源。”——吟游诗人特丽莎
entries.en:
Translations of an alien philosopher's teachings. It contains several analyses and ponderings on the meaning of life and the purpose of the cosmos. By having our rulers follow this advice, we can make more informed decisions.

"The answer to the purpose of the cosmos lies outside of us, but that does not make us less inclined to find it. We must strive for unity in order to reach the answer at the root of all things." - Telisa, the Teller of Tales

entries.zh:
出自一位异星哲学家讲义的译本。她在外交谈判中的奇闻异事可以作为外交行事的优秀范例。

“初次和星系的孩童们见面难免害怕，但这是一份难能的希望。善待你的邻居，为它的存在而欢欣——它们带来的是几万年被冰冷太空隔绝时代的终结”。——吟游诗人特丽莎
entries.en:
Translations of an alien philosopher's teachings. Her anecdotes from diplomatic negotiations may act as a good basis for diplomatic negotiations.

"Encountering the children of the cosmos might feel harrowing, but ultimately it is an opportunity for hope. Be host to your neighbor and relish in their existence, as the blessing they bring is an end to the isolation of the void." - Telisa, the Teller of Tales

entries.zh:
出自一位异星哲学家讲义的译本。她对战争的描述和对战略的独到见解是军方绝佳的教材。

“团结一致是我们制胜的法宝。然而，长年累月的和平让我们军队内部出现裂痕。这些裂痕必须破除，哪怕需要绝对的手段。唯有破而后立，才能涅槃重生。”——吟游诗人特丽莎
entries.en:
Translations of an alien philosopher's teachings. Her depictions of war and ideas on combat strategy could make excellent training material for our military.

"Creating unity is the biggest challenge, particularly because sustainability often generates borders. These borders need to be torn down - a sentiment which scares many. One must sometimes be willing to tear down in order to build something stronger from the ashes." - Telisa, the Teller of Tales

entries.zh: 花费资源和时间工作环境进行改善，这毫无疑问会提高工人的幸福度和生产效率。\n\n
entries.en: Spending time and resources to improve the working conditions of our people will surely result in better results and happier workers.\n\n

entries.zh: 我们可以进一步限制有毒燃料和不可再生资源的使用，以推进新能源生产的研究。这样能够使我们的能量循环更加臻于完美，并创造一个人人安居乐业的生活环境。\n\n
entries.en: We can further limit the use of toxic fuels and non-renewable resources in order to promote research into new methods of energy production. This could help us come closer to a perfect energy cycle and improve the environment for our people to enjoy.\n\n

entries.zh: 研究过高级传感器技术之后，我们获得了足够的信息，能够将额外的资源用到增强搜寻扫描上。使用这种技术，我们的技师会更容易在我们恒星系的边缘找到特殊目标。\n\n
entries.en: After having researched advanced sensor technology we have enough information to pour extra resources into enhancing our own search scans. Our technicians would have an easier time finding objects of interest at the edge of our systems with this initiative.\n\n

entries.zh: 进化产生了能够流出酸液的植物，使人很难横穿丛林或在此殖民。
entries.en: Evolution has produced trees and foliage that exude acids and make the terrain dangerous to traverse or settle in.

entries.zh: 这条小行星带是一个曾经拥有生命的行星的残骸。
entries.en: The asteroid belt used to be a planet with the promise of life.

entries.zh: 许多星舰曾在此毁灭，将此处变成了一个星舰塚；这里很多材料唾手可得。
entries.en: A multitude of starships have crashed here, creating a figurative graveyard full of materials to scavenge.

entries.zh: 在这颗星球上有一支坠毁的舰队，它是由人工智能控制；这给我们提供了珍贵的工程数据以供研究。
entries.en: A fleet controlled by an AI lies destroyed on the planet, giving us valuable engineering data to research.

entries.zh: 这颗星球被射线轰击了，其上的绝大部分区域都不再适宜生物生存。
entries.en: The planet has been bombarded with radiation, making large parts of it dangerous to most living creatures.

entries.zh: 一个古老的存在。其居住在深海之下，是该星球上最强大的存在。
entries.en: An ancient being, living deep beneath the waves, is the dominating life force on this planet.

entries.zh: 星球上的植物群提供了富含营养的水果和物质，可以改进生存环境。
entries.en: The planet's flora provides nutritious fruits and substances that improves living conditions.

entries.zh: 一个强大的传感器阵列能够探测到更加详细的周边情况。
entries.en: A strong sensor array provides a greater overview of the surrounding area.

entries.zh: 驯化四足动物来减轻工作负担，尽管它们是被强迫的。
entries.en: Domesticated quadrupeds help alleviate work conditions, although not willingly.

entries.zh: 驯化四足动物来减轻工作负担，尽管它们是不情愿的。
entries.en: Domesticated quadrupeds help alleviate work conditions, although reluctantly.

entries.zh: 与我们结盟的四足动物可以减轻工作负担。
entries.en: Allied quadrupeds help alleviate work conditions.

entries.zh: 行星上有着一些失落的文明建造的机器人，给我们提供了珍贵的工程数据以供研究。
entries.en: The planet holds old robots built by a fallen society, giving us engineering material to research.

entries.zh: 非常奇异的动物在这颗行星上栖居。它们提供了有趣的社会学研究机会。
entries.en: Particularly odd animals inhabit this planet. They provide interesting society research opportunities.

entries.zh: 这颗星球上的原生生物似乎对我们很不友好。
entries.en: The planet is host to hostile creatures that are not happy to see us.

entries.zh: 这颗沙漠行星由近乎液态的沙子组成，使得在上面建造变得极为困难。
entries.en: The desert planet consists of a near-liquid grained sand that makes construction extremely difficult.

entries.zh: 这个星球被近乎液态的沙子所覆盖，奇特的矿物成分提供了大量的研究机会。
entries.en: Sand covers this planet, so fine grained it resembles a liquid. The odd composition of minerals provide ample amounts of research.

entries.zh: 一个古老的采矿设施围绕着这个星球旋转，证明这里有可能有潜在的资源。
entries.en: An old mining station was orbiting the planet, showing that there's potential resources to be had here.

entries.zh: 在这颗星球上建立殖民地以开发其资源。\n£energy£ §G+50%§!
entries.en: Construct a colony on this planet to begin tapping its resource.\n£energy£ §G+50%§!

entries.zh: 对这颗星球上稀有自然资源的开采会在短期内大幅度增加整体能源生产。
entries.en: The sparse natural resources on this planet are currently being mined to boost the overall energy production.

entries.zh: 节省这颗星球上的珍稀气体资源可在长期内保持能源生产的效益。
entries.en: Saving a sparse yet valuable gas resource on this planet helps to make its energy production more efficient in the long term.

entries.zh: 这颗星球上的一部分人口曾因为反抗政府而被镇压。
entries.en: A certain part of the population of this planet has been violently suppressed for their opposition of the government.

entries.zh: 这部分人口在恐惧中劳动，害怕外星工厂会夺取更多人命
entries.en: The population works in fear that an alien factory will take more lives.

entries.zh: 付出金钱和努力确保外星工厂的工作环境安全。
entries.en: Cost and effort goes into making sure an alien factory is secure to work in.

entries.zh: 罪犯受到惩戒，促使人们采取行动。
entries.en: Offenders have been punished in order to motivate the people to action.

entries.zh: 一种传染性很强的疾病散播开来，新的困境出现，人们受到威胁。
entries.en: A highly infectious disease has been let loose, creating new strands and endangering the population.

entries.zh: 人们对所谓天人的真面目产生了不同的理解，信念不和导致人们兵戎相见。
entries.en: The people have broken out into an all out war due to a religious conflict regarding the true nature of the 'Skyborn God'.

entries.zh: 无论合理与否，由于自动化带来的失业恐慌正在这颗星球上蔓延。
entries.en: Whether justified or not, fears of unemployment due to automation are affecting this planet.

entries.zh: 这颗行星上的机器人和有机人口之间关系紧张，降低了我们的£unity£凝聚力产出。
entries.en: Tensions between robotic and organic populations on the planet have reduced our £unity£ Unity output.

entries.zh: 一个牵涉到社会研究的实验室AI遭受了严重的硬件损害，现在正在被相关人员替换。
entries.en: A lab AI involved in societal research has suffered terminal hardware damage and is being replaced.

entries.zh: 蛇！到处都是蛇！我们对付这些东西疲于奔命，无暇……顾及其他事情。
entries.en: Snakes! Snakes everywhere! We're too busy dealing with them to do... other things.

entries.zh: 本不想惊动你，但那些蛇缠绕在发电机上吮吸着能量。
entries.en: Don't want to alarm you, but snakes are coiled around the generators and draining power.

entries.zh: 该行星上几乎所有的生命形式均已消亡，并且在巨大的能量冲击化为碎片。唯一过去智慧生命存在的迹象是一座支离破碎的空间站以及破碎地表下发出的零星信号。
entries.en: This planet has been stripped of almost all life and shattered by a massive burst of energy. The only signs of previous intelligent life on this world are a crumbling orbital space station and sporadic traces under the broken surface.

entries.zh: 这颗行星上存在大量脆弱但繁殖迅速的生物。任何试图在地表生存的人都必须调整他们的基础设施以适应大型昆虫的偶尔袭击。
entries.en: This planet boasts a large population of easy-to-dispatch but rapidly reproducing creatures. Anyone trying to survive on the surface will have to adapt their infrastructure to occasional attacks by large insects.

entries.zh: 高耸的矿质结构将翻腾的气体送入热层。
entries.en: Towering mineral structures that send gases billowing into the thermosphere.

entries.zh: 原封不动的平流层喷口
这些壮观的平流层排放口被保持原样以便缇扬奇享用那些气体。
entries.en: These magnificent stratospheric vents have been left untouched to allow Tiyanki to graze on the gases.

entries.zh: 这些巨型的平流层喷口的排放物被收集精炼成为宝贵的异星天然气。
entries.en: The emissions from these massive stratospheric vents have been redirected and refined into precious Exotic Gases.

entries.zh: 平流层喷口旅游业在更高的层次上有专门的观景台来观察强大的缇扬奇的进食行为。
entries.en: Stratospheric vent tourism on a higher level with dedicated viewing platforms to observe the feeding behavior of the mighty Tiyanki.

entries.zh: 成功爆破出地下气体的新出口带来了产量的提升。
entries.en: The successful detonation of new pathways for underground gases has led to increased production.

entries.zh: 喷口扩张计划的部分性失败导致了产量的降低，但同时产生了丰富的矿物储藏。
entries.en: While the partial failure of our vent expansion has reduced production, it also created rich mineral deposits.

entries.zh: 这颗星球倍受黑暗之力的折磨。悲惨淹没了生产的繁荣。
entries.en: This world suffers from the presence of a dark force. Production blooms in sadness.
The Remnants of the Court of Blossoms

entries.zh: 该星球在曾为鲜花之庭的断壁残垣之上繁荣发展。
entries.en: This world thrives upon the remnants of what was once the Court of Blossoms.

entries.zh: 从这一天起，我们和阿纳萨里的命运牢牢地交织在一起。我们能一起培植未来，星球上已经焕发出新的生机，天空也充满了希望。
entries.en: From this day forth, our destinies intertwine with the Anathari. Together, we shall cultivate a shared future, and already the world stirs with new life,its skies alight with promise.

entries.zh: 黑水晶能够让周围的人感受到幸福。
entries.en: The black crystal brings happiness to everyone in its vicinity.

entries.zh: 黑水晶是由一种能够增强方舟推进能力的物质组成的。
entries.en: The Black Crystal was composed of a substance that enhances the propulsion capabilities of the arkship.

entries.zh: 科学家们一次次来到这件文物前，它带来的诸多洞见深深地吸引着我们的注意。
entries.en: Our scientists repeatedly return to the artifact, consistently captivated by the persistent potential for new insights it continues to yield.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!方舟上的每个人都被撒欢的缇扬奇幼崽迷住了，大家比以前更加开心和放松。
entries.en: Everyone on the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! is mesmerized by the playing tiyanki calves and feeling much more happy and relaxed than before.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!方舟现在运行地更快更高效了。
entries.en: The systems on the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! are faster and more efficient.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!方舟上的人们现在更加轻松和快乐了。
entries.en: The population on the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§! feels lighter and happier.

entries.zh: 这一祭祀物品的重新安放在方舟舰§Y[Root.GetName]§!上引起了动荡。即便如此，它那超自然的对称性仍散发出一种奇特的吸引力。
entries.en: The relocation of this ceremonial object has stirred unrest aboard the Arkship §Y[Root.GetName]§!. Even so, its unnatural symmetry exerts a curious fascination.

entries.zh: 我们从回收的以太巨龙的鳞片中获得的知识改良了方舟舰的防御机制。
entries.en: The knowledge we have gained from harvesting the Ether Dragon scales improves the defensive mechanisms of our Arkship.

entries.zh: 为了遏制真菌爆发，农业区被故意一把火烧了，在清除感染的同时，也导致粮食产量大幅下降。
entries.en: Agricultural sections have been deliberately set ablaze to halt the fungal outbreak, drastically reducing food production while purging the infestation.

entries.zh: 入侵§Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!上的菌丝体网络已完成改造，用于增强营养物质再分配，显著提高了农业效率和整体粮食产量。
entries.en: The invasive mycelial network on §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! has been adapted to enhance nutrient redistribution, significantly improving agricultural efficiency and overall food output.

entries.zh: §Y方舟舰[Root.GetName]§!上的菌丝体网络现已与我们的农业系统协同工作，通过独特的共生关系增强了作物的韧性并优化了养分分配。
entries.en: The fungal network aboard §YArkship [Root.GetName]§! now cooperates with our agricultural systems, enhancing crop resilience and nutrient distribution through a unique symbiotic bond.

entries.zh: 方舟舰上的一个未经授权的区段已进行了拆除，空间得到了重新规划利用，从而腾出了居住空间并改善了生活条件。
entries.en: An unauthorized section of the Arkship has been demolished and the space repurposed, freeing up room for housing and improving living conditions.

entries.zh: 一处隐秘的康养场所已获准正式开放，为机组人员提供休息与康复之地，以提升其福祉。
entries.en: A hidden wellness retreat has been officially permitted, providing a place of rest and recovery that improves the wellbeing of the crew.

entries.zh: 未经授权的居民已被移出方舟舰，船上恢复了秩序与稳定。
entries.en: The unauthorized inhabitants have been removed from the Arkship, restoring a sense of order and stability aboard.

entries.zh: 异见分子已被强行移出方舟舰。秩序已得到稳固恢复，尽管这一严厉举措在船员心中留下了拂面阴影。
entries.en: The dissenters have been forcibly removed from the Arkship. Order has been firmly restored, though the harshness of the action has left its mark on the crew.
